single-source tenders skip competitive bidding entirely. high emd requirements price out smaller vendors. these are the highest-stakes no-contest awards in the dataset.
bid windows under 7 days leave no time for outsiders to prepare. short windows on high-value open tenders strongly suggest a pre-selected vendor with advance notice.

    product category breakdown (from 30k scraped records)
      8 charts across 30k detailed records + 2.8m macro dataset

      bid window distribution - the spike at exactly 7 days (1,266 tenders) is not random. orgs have learned the minimum. anything in red gave vendors under a week.

      tender type breakdown - 465 single-source tenders in this dataset. small percentage, highest scrutiny warranted.

      single-source by org - ministry of railways issues 118, more than double bhel (46) and ongc (38). three of the top five are defence or energy.

      emd vs bid window scatter - each dot is a tender. red = single-source, orange = rush (<=7d). the cluster of high-emd short-window tenders is the investigative sweet spot.

      total emd at stake by sector - civil works and power projects have the most money locked in security deposits, not railways (which dominates by count but not value).

      zero-emd rate by org type - over half of all tenders carry no security deposit. autonomous bodies are the worst offenders. no emd means no financial accountability if a vendor ghosts.

      rush tenders by emd bracket - most rush tenders have zero emd. but 200+ have emd >1cr, meaning crore-scale contracts were rushed through with no time for outside bidders.

      active vs archived - orgs ranked by active tender count. municipal corporation of delhi and delhi development authority dominate current live procurement.
